name: loc_interest_8_months
title: Line Of Credit Interest Estimate
prompt: read_file loan_terms.txt and balance_schedule.csv. APR = (prime + margin) / 100 as a decimal. For each CSV data row: interest = balance * APR * days / 365. Sum all months with run_lua using FILES['balance_schedule.csv']; print and submit the total rounded to 2 decimals.

loan_terms.txt: Line of credit APR = prime rate 6.45% + margin 1.75%. Use simple daily interest on a 365-day basis.
